chunks.sanskrit: arkendudīpādyavabhāsabhinnaṃ nābhātyativyāptatayā tataśca | prakāśarūpaṃ tadiyatprakāśyaprakāśatākhyā vyavahāra eva
chunks.l1:
## par-p01 (1)
of-sun-moon-lamp-and-the-rest / illumination / distinct-from / not / shines / on-account-of-over-pervasion / and / hence / of-the-nature-of-light / that / just-this-much / illumined-illuminator-named / convention / indeed // par-p01
chunks.l2: Distinct from the illumination of sun, moon, lamp and the rest, it does not shine — on account of over-pervasion; and hence: of the nature of light, just this much — illumined-illuminator named is mere convention.
chunks.l3:
Unlike the light of sun, moon, lamp — it does not shine, pervading too completely. Hence:
of light-nature itself — ‘His illumined-and-illuminator’ is a mere transacting name.
chunks.c1:
## par-p01 — C1

**SUMMARY.** Distinct from every lit thing, light itself does not shine as an object — too pervasive to appear; illumined-vs-illuminator is mere convention.

*Rasa: śānta (tranquility) with adbhuta (wonder) — The sthāyibhāva is knowledge (jñāna) in the mode of demotion of subject-object; the vyabhicāri is wonder (camatkāra) at light's over-pervasion.*
chunks.argmap:
## par-p01 — argument map

Light itself does not shine as an object — too pervasive to appear. Illumined-vs-illuminator is mere convention (vyavahāra). What is, is light, unobjectifiable because everywhere.

### Open
- Whether 'iyat' (just this much) limits or affirms is unresolved.

chunks.sanskrit: jñānadvibhinno na hi kaścidarthaḥ tattatkṛtaḥ saṃvidi nāsti bhedaḥ | svayamprakāśācchatam aikadhāmni prātisvikī nāpi vibheditā syāt
chunks.l1:
## par-p02 (2)
dually-distinct-from-knowledge / not / indeed / any / thing / made-of-this-and-that / in-consciousness / not / exists / difference / from-self-luminosity / hundredfold / in-the-one-abode / individual / not-indeed / divided / would-be // par-p02
chunks.l2: No thing at all is dually distinct from knowledge; made of this and that, in consciousness there is no difference. From self-luminosity, hundredfold, in the one abode — the individual would not indeed be divided.
chunks.l3:
Nothing at all stands dually apart from knowledge; made of this and that, in consciousness there is no split.
From self-luminosity, a hundredfold, in the one abode — the individual would never be divided.
chunks.c1:
## par-p02 — C1

**SUMMARY.** No thing stands dually apart from knowledge; in consciousness there is no difference; the individual, in the one abode of self-luminosity, stays undivided.

*Rasa: śānta (tranquility) with adbhuta (wonder) — The sthāyibhāva is knowledge (jñāna) in the mode of non-duality; the vyabhicāri is wonder at the individual undivided.*
chunks.argmap:
## par-p02 — argument map

No thing stands dually apart from knowledge. In consciousness there is no difference. The individual, in the one abode of self-luminosity, stays undivided.

### Open
- 'śatam' (hundredfold) vs 'satatam' (always) — print form kept, flagged.

chunks.sanskrit: itthaṃ svasaṃvidghana eka eva śivaḥ sa viśvasya paraḥ prakāśaḥ | tatrāpi bhātyeva vicitraśaktau grāhyagṛhītṛpravibhāgabhedaḥ
chunks.l1:
## par-p03 (3)
thus / own-consciousness-dense / one / indeed / Śiva / he / of-the-universe / supreme / light / there / even / shines / indeed / in-variegated-power / apprehended / apprehender / division / difference // par-p03
chunks.l2: Thus — dense own-consciousness, one indeed: he is Śiva, the universe's supreme light. There too, indeed, shines, in variegated power: apprehended-apprehender-division-difference.
chunks.l3:
Thus — dense self-consciousness, one alone: He is Śiva, the universe’s supreme light.
And there too, in variegated power, shines the split of grasped and grasper.
chunks.c1:
## par-p03 — C1

**SUMMARY.** Dense, one own-consciousness is Śiva himself, the universe's supreme light — yet grasper-grasped division still shines within variegated power.

*Rasa: śānta (tranquility) with adbhuta (wonder) — The sthāyibhāva is knowledge (jñāna) in the mode of positive declaration; the vyabhicāri is wonder that division shines without dividing.*
chunks.argmap:
## par-p03 — argument map

Dense, one own-consciousness is Śiva himself, the universe's supreme light. Yet grasper-grasped division still shines within variegated power. Division shines without dividing the light.

### Open
- Whether 'ittham' (thus) refers back to p01-p02 or opens a new movement is unresolved.

chunks.sanskrit: bhedaḥ sa cāyaṃ na tato vibhinnaḥ svacchandasusvacchatamaikadhāmnaḥ | prāsādahastyaśvapayodasindhugiryādi yadvanmaṇidarpaṇādeḥ
chunks.l1:
## par-p04 (4)
difference / that / and / this / not / thence / different / free / most-perfectly-clear / of-the-one-abode / palace / elephant / horse / cloud / ocean / mountain / etcetera / just-as / of-jewel-mirror-and-the-like // par-p04
chunks.l2: That difference, and this — not different thence: of the free, most-perfectly-clear one-abode. Palace, elephant, horse, cloud, ocean, mountain and the rest — just as of jewel-mirror and the like.
chunks.l3:
That split — and this one — is not cut off from it: from the free, the flawlessly clear, the single abode.
Palace, elephant, horse, cloud, ocean, mountain, and the rest — just as with jewel, mirror, and the like.
chunks.c1:
## par-p04 — C1

**SUMMARY.** Difference is not cut off from its ground — free, most-clear, one-abode — then the bare list against the jewel-mirror: palace through mountain, just as from jewel-mirror and the like.

*Rasa: śānta (tranquility) — The sthāyibhāva is knowledge (jñāna) in the mode of analogy; the vyabhicāri is clarity (prasāda) of the mirror list.*
chunks.argmap:
## par-p04 — argument map

Difference is not cut off from its ground — free, most-clear, one-abode. Then the bare list: palace, elephant, horse, cloud, ocean, mountain. Just as of jewel-mirror and the like — reflected things need no ground but the clear mirror.

### Open
- Whether the list is exhaustive or exemplary is unresolved.

chunks.sanskrit: ādarśakukṣau pratibimbakāri sabimbakaṃ syād yadi mānasiddham | svacchandasaṃvinmukhuraantarāle bhāveṣu hetvantaram asti nānyat
chunks.l1:
## par-p05 (5)
of-mirror / in-belly / reflection / making / with-prototype / would-be / if / mind-proven / free / consciousness / mirror / in-the-interior / among-things / cause / other / is / not / other // par-p05
chunks.l2: If, in a mirror's belly, the reflection-making with-prototype would be mind-proven — then in the interior of the mirror of free consciousness, among things there is no other cause besides.
chunks.l3:
If, in a mirror’s belly, a reflection — image-making, with its original — were proved by mind alone —
then, within the mirror of free consciousness, things have no other cause at all.
chunks.c1:
## par-p05 — C1

**SUMMARY.** If even a common mirror shows prototype-with-reflection as mind-established, the free-consciousness mirror needs no other cause among things.

*Rasa: śānta (tranquility) — The sthāyibhāva is knowledge (jñāna) in the mode of a fortiori; the vyabhicāri is clarity (prasāda) of mind-proven reflection.*
chunks.argmap:
## par-p05 — argument map

If a common mirror shows prototype-with-reflection as mind-established... ...then the free-consciousness mirror needs no other cause among things. Mukhura read as mukura (mirror) — print form kept, reading marked.

### Open
- Mukhura/mukura reading is an editorial decision, marked here.

chunks.sanskrit: saṃvidghanas tena parastvam eva tvayyeva viśvāni cakāsati drāk | sphuranti ca tvanmahasaḥ prabhāvāt tvam eva caiṣāṃ parameśakartā
chunks.l1:
## par-p06 (6)
O-consciousness-dense-one / therefore / supreme / you / indeed / in-you / indeed / universes / shine / at-once / flash-forth / and / your / of-glory / by-power / you / indeed / and / of-these / supreme-Lord / maker // par-p06
chunks.l2: O consciousness-dense one — therefore you indeed are supreme; in you indeed the universes shine at once. And they flash forth by the power of your glory; you indeed are also their supreme-Lord maker.
chunks.l3:
O dense consciousness — therefore You alone are supreme; in You alone the worlds shine all at once.
And they flash by Your glory’s power — and You alone are their maker, the supreme Lord.
chunks.c1:
## par-p06 — C1

**SUMMARY.** O consciousness-dense one: you indeed are supreme; in you the universes shine at once, flashing by glory-power; you stand as both their maker and their supreme Lord.

*Rasa: ānanda (bliss) with adbhuta (wonder) — The sthāyibhāva is knowledge (jñāna) in the mode of address (nirṇaya); the vyabhicāri is joy (harṣa) that all shines in you.*
chunks.argmap:
## par-p06 — argument map

O consciousness-dense one: you indeed are supreme. In you the universes shine at once, flashing by glory-power. You stand as both their maker and their supreme Lord.

### Open
- Whether 'drāk' (at once) modifies shining or flashing is unresolved.

chunks.sanskrit: itthaṃ svasaṃvedanam ādisiddham asādhyam ātmānam anīśam īśam | svaśaktisaṃpūrṇavadeśakālaṃ nityaṃ vibhuṃ bhairavanātham īḍe
chunks.l1:
## par-p07 (7)
thus / self-consciousness / primordially-established / unaccomplishable / self / non-lord / lord / whose-place-and-time-are-full-of-own-power / eternal / pervasive / Bhairava-Lord / I-praise // par-p07
chunks.l2: Thus — self-consciousness, primordially established, unaccomplishable; the self, non-lord, lord; whose place and time are full of own power — eternal, pervasive: Bhairava-Lord, I praise.
chunks.l3:
Thus — self-consciousness, established from the first, never to be effected; the self, no lord and yet lord;
whose place and time are full of its own power — eternal, pervasive: Bhairava, Lord, I praise.
chunks.c1:
## par-p07 — C1

**SUMMARY.** Established yet unaccomplishable, non-lord yet lord, place-and-time full of own power — eternal, pervasive: Bhairava-Lord, I praise.

*Rasa: śānta (tranquility) — The sthāyibhāva is knowledge (jñāna) in the mode of paradox; the vyabhicāri is wonder (camatkāra) at incompatible predicates held.*
chunks.argmap:
## par-p07 — argument map

Self-consciousness, primordially established, unaccomplishable. Non-lord and lord at once — three incompatible predicates held. Whose place and time are full of own power: eternal, pervasive — Bhairava-Lord, I praise.

### Open
- 'vadeśakālam' is obscure; glossed neutrally, marked here.

chunks.sanskrit: sadvṛttasaptakam idaṃ galitānyacintāḥ samyak smaranti hṛdaye paramārthakāmāḥ | te bhairavīya paradhāma muhur viśanti jānanti ca trijagatīparamārthacarcām
chunks.l1:
## par-p08 (8)
of-good-conduct / septad / this / dissolved / other / thoughts / rightly / remember / in-heart / desiring-the-ultimate / those / O-Bhairava's-one / supreme-abode / again / enter / know / and / of-three-worlds / ultimate-thing-discussion // par-p08
chunks.l2: This septad of good conduct — dissolved other thoughts — those desiring the ultimate rightly remember in the heart. Those, O Bhairava's one, again enter the supreme abode, and know the ultimate-thing-discussion of the three worlds.
chunks.l3:
This sevenfold good conduct — those whose other thoughts have melted, who long for the ultimate, rightly remember in the heart.
And they — O Bhairava’s own — enter the supreme abode again and again, and know the ultimate discourse of the three worlds.
chunks.c1:
## par-p08 — C1

**SUMMARY.** The conduct-septad remembered in the heart; the abode entered again; the discussion itself known — it names its own close.

*Rasa: śānta (tranquility) — The sthāyibhāva is knowledge (jñāna) in the mode of close (nigamana); the vyabhicāri is peace (śānti) of conduct remembered.*
chunks.argmap:
## par-p08 — argument map

The conduct-septad remembered in the heart by those whose other thoughts are dissolved. Those enter the supreme abode again, and know the ultimate-thing-discussion. The hymn names itself at the close.

### Open
- Whether 'bhairavīya' is vocative address or genitive is unresolved.
